## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off by a person (`git commit -s`); AI agents are credited with `Co-Authored-By`, never sign off
- [ ] New files carry the SPDX header of their directory; new dependencies pass `cargo deny check`
- [ ] Clean sources: nothing from commercial games, decompilations, ports or proprietary SDKs
- [ ] New content is listed in the asset manifest with its licence
- [ ] A changed decision is a new entry in `design/decisions.md`
